Ring or small brooch: oval shell cameo of a dancing figure, white-metal mount. Pendant: round Satsuma-style flowering tree, cobalt and gilt border, white-metal frame and bail. Brooch: white-metal spray with marcasite-set leaves and one pearl, in Hardy Bros Ltd case with 'to Her Majesty the Queen' warrant text on the lid satin. Case satin stained and worn.

lots.question_for_gowans: Is the cameo bracelet marked 800 or sterling (check clasp and backs), are any cameo panels cracked or loose, and is the brooch in the Hardy Bros case marked silver or 9ct, with a real pearl?
